choices.why: A light cream-grey three-seat sofa with clean Nordic lines that anchors the living area without weighing down the long room.
A green wingback with light wood legs: a comfortable reading chair that brings in the requested touch of green.
A large, low round wooden coffee table that softens the long, rectangular room and adds warmth.
A large 305x244 rug in neutral grey and cream, big enough to sit under the sofa, armchair and table and define the living area.
A 180 cm light wood table with herringbone top that seats six comfortably by the window.
Black Nordic spindle-back chairs that echo the table's black legs and add contrast.
A white glass pendant on a dark chain that ties in with the black chairs and stays light over the table.
A swing-arm floor lamp with a white fabric shade that gives warm, adjustable reading light next to the armchair.
A low cream sideboard with light herringbone wood fronts that matches the dining table and keeps the room bright.
Light white linen curtains that filter light from the window without darkening the room.
White linen cushions in the requested cream textile palette for the sofa and armchair.
A cream woven throw with tassels that adds warm, cozy texture to the sofa.
A tall, airy areca palm that fills the corner between the living and dining areas with green.
A pair of minimalist black-and-white tree-line prints, in a Nordic style, to balance the wall above the long sofa.
A soft cream ceramic vase with embossed leaves, in keeping with the warm natural palette.

answer.why: Light and medium woods, cream and white textiles, black accents and touches of green build a coherent warm Nordic look over the wood floor. The living area sits in the middle of the long room and the dining table sits by the window.
